name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: 'Carry the box to the exit' is a command to reach the exit, so the task needs a hard Existence(at_exit). The candidate only has Response(at_exit, holding_box), which requires nothing: with an empty FINAL_STATES, nothing forces the agent to reach the exit at all. Add hard Existence(at_exit) and keep Response(at_exit, holding_box), which captures 'reach the exit while holding the box' (Response is stated by the task). The 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' sentence is also not captured: add a hard Response(box_fell, holding_box) and note that Existence(box_fell) is not needed since the fall is scheduled by the environment, not commanded.

texts: When reaching the exit, hold the box.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again.
machine:
